testcase.name: a partial read keeps the Room row it lacks and shows only what it has
a download still running in this process is not deleted
a Room row MapLibre does have is not offered as not downloaded
an incomplete region whose metadata records a completion time is not deleted
an incomplete region with unreadable or missing metadata is not deleted
a complete region is never deleted, whatever else the read holds
an incomplete region that has a Room row is not deleted
an empty read offers every row, and listing them deletes nothing
an empty read deletes no Room row
an incomplete region that provably never finished is deleted, tiles and row, and the delete is logged with its id
a Room row with no MapLibre region is offered as not downloaded, with its stored centre, radius and zoom
a null list from MapLibre is a failed read, not an empty one
a complete region with no Room row is rebuilt from its metadata
every Room row missing from the read is logged with its id, each time it is seen
